text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leading up to the Fan Appreciation Festival.
Discussions were held in each class about what events to put on, but—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: U-Um... I have a suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
How about running a soup kitchen?
There are still areas struggling, after all...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I think going there and setting up a soup kitchen
would really be appreciated, though."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I get how you feel, but...
Isn't the Fan Appreciation Festival supposed to be held inside Tracen Academy?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I don't think we'll get permission
to head out from our side, though...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Now that you mention it...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry. I didn't think it through.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —Espo-san.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... you haven't been acting like yourself, Tran.
Not for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan, quick question.
I want to do something for the
Fan Appreciation Festival too, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Got any ideas? Since we can't go on-site,
our options are pretty limited...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We made proposals from various angles.
Such as fundraising activities,
or plans to invite local children.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho, I see, as expected.
Thanks, Trainie. That helps a lot, in all sorts of ways.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I just haven't been able to
organize my thoughts properly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural.
That's just how deeply it hurt her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to lend a hand wherever I could,
even outside of training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And on the day of the race.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Too bad, Trainy.
Looks like those kids couldn't make it after all.
choice_data_list: Yeah, but it can't be helped.
Yeah, but it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I tried inviting them, but it seems they're still in no condition to go on a long trip.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
“Still, there's still things we can do!
Let's give it all we got, our own way.”

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please consider donating
to help with the recovery efforts!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Lookin' forward to it~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Even just a little bit is fine.
Please, lend me your strength and feelings!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Please~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Please, by all means!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Isn't that Transcend over there?
She's been working hard on dirt lately...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: You're right. Maybe I should lend them a hand.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Thank you for your cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... Acting all hyper like this
takes my breath away~. But I can keep going...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend's desperate plea
seemed to touch the hearts of a few people.
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we got a decent amount of attention.
Like, it really felt like it worked.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Tran-chan.
You worked so hard out there. As expected of the mastermind behind it all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah……

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"It's nothing.
It really is nothing..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Thank you all... for helping me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fundraiser was a modest success,
but even so, Transcend still seemed
somewhat disheartened.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, wait, isn't that Transcend?
The one who's been killing it lately!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You're right. They're working so hard...
Hey, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Thank you for your cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... Acting all hyper like this
takes my breath away~. But I can keep going...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend's desperate plea
seemed to touch the hearts of many people.
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: That was amazing! I can't believe so many people came to watch!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, huge success! Especially since Tran-chan
worked super hard!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah……

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"It's nothing.
It really is nothing..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, everyone...
Even I didn't think things would go this well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a result beyond what anyone could have hoped for. Even so, Transcend had a somewhat gloomy look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No.
It's just, I was thinking...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
They say that even if information gets conveyed,
empathy doesn't necessarily spread with it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... A lot of people lent a hand with this fundraiser, right?
I'm really grateful for that, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I could feel it... The cheerfulness in her voice... was different from when she was actually there.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please consider donating
to help with the recovery efforts!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Lookin' forward to it~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Even just a little bit is fine.
Please, lend me your strength and feelings!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Please~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The tone was different.
A little different from the locals...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Still, that makes sense.
It's not like I know anyone here,
and the northern country is just way too far away...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And that wasn't just limited to
Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I'll go further west and south too.
And I've really felt how empathy fades the farther away the distance gets."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Even when chatting in message groups, sometimes it doesn't even come up as a topic anymore.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's natural for the tone to be different.
It's natural, but still...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I just can't help wondering
if it's really okay to leave things like this.
Whenever I think about those girls."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I thought, 'Isn't there something we gotta do
to get more people on board?'

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Even more than running.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... Sorry.
That was, well... just in the heat of the moment.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, forget it.
Still... Still, somehow... little by little...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if everything I've done up until now
will even matter in the future...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel like there were signs... before now.
But right now, I felt it crystal clear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend begins to lose her focus.
Starting from her feet, bit by bit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: All the information I've gathered. But what if, according to that information, what I want to achieve is completely meaningless?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just what will Transcend run for from now on—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I was... wrong all along.
More than all that excitement and thrills, I should have..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Right now, more than anything, I want to win it back for her.
I always thought it had no value at all...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: To my former... boring everyday life.
